system.description:
Action
Reaction · when a visible caster finishes a spell
SP
5
Attribute
Class casting attribute
Range
The spell; caster within 8 squares
Duration
Instant

Add 3/5/7 cancellation progress toward target 2 plus its printed SP cost. At completion it ends before resolving. Otherwise its caster receives 2 Banes on any resolution roll, and incomplete cancellation progress expires.
